body_text:
For any linear transformation $T : V \to W$, the *dual map* (or transpose)
$T^* : W^* \to V^*$ is defined by precomposition:
$$ T^*(\psi) = \psi \circ T \quad \text{for all } \psi \in W^*. $$
Duality reverses the direction of arrows: a measurement functional on the
target space $W$ pulls back to a measurement on the domain $V$.
In finite dimensions, the matrix of $T^*$ relative to dual bases is precisely
the transpose of the matrix of $T$: $[T^*]_{\mathcal{C}^*}^{\mathcal{B}^*} = ([T]_{\mathcal{B}}^{\mathcal{C}})^T$.
